ig_carousel_topic.topic: What 'units' actually mean (and why win % alone is a lie)
ig_carousel_topic.slide1_text:
Your win rate can be 58% and you can still lose money.
Here is why.
ig_carousel_topic.slide2_text:
Most bettors track wins and losses.
That number tells you almost nothing on its own.
A 60% win rate at -200 odds loses money long-term.
ig_carousel_topic.slide3_text:
Units measure how much you actually profit relative to your stake.
One unit is typically 1% of your bankroll.
A 54% win rate at the right odds beats a 62% win rate at bad ones.
ig_carousel_topic.slide4_text:
Example: 100 bets, 54 wins, 46 losses.
All bets at -110 odds.
Result: 54 x 0.909u won, 46 x 1u lost. Net: +3.1u. Profitable.
Same record at -150 odds: net -8.7u. Losing.
ig_carousel_topic.slide5_text:
Odds shape everything. Track units, not just wins.
Our YTD: 240-200, 54.5% win rate, +38.3u, 9.3% ROI.
The last number is the one that matters.
